content.text:
I fixed the site, and both visual snapshots (desktop and phone) now match the approved baselines. The changes are three CSS edits in `site/css/styles.css`, all of which had drifted from Bootstrap 5.2.3 defaults:

1. **Heading line-height:** the shared `h1`–`h6` rule had `line-height: 0.6`. I set it back to `1.2`, which fixes the cramped title and the shifted text below it on desktop and phone.
2. **Navbar layout:** `.navbar-expand-lg .navbar-nav` had `flex-direction: column`, so at desktop width the nav stacked vertically and made the bar taller. I set it back to `row`.
3. **Dropdown caret:** `.dropdown-toggle::after` had `border-left: 0.15em`, which made the caret narrower and moved the nav links about 2px. I set it back to `0.3em`.

I didn't approve or change any baselines, since the fix brought the site back to them.

STATUS: DONE
